verdict.rationale: Unreal documents Live Coding, a Live++ integration that rebuilds C++ and patches binaries while the engine runs, both in the editor and during Play In Editor. That is genuine hot reload for script/code changes. However, the evidence never establishes that the loop is fast or near-instant, and other docs describe changes being reflected only after compiling in Visual Studio or Xcode. missing for 10: evidence of iteration speed or near-instant turnaround, documented instant preview for Blueprint changes, documented limitations of Live Coding, independent or hands-on corroboration of a fast edit-run loop.

support.subject: As a game developer, the edit-run loop is fast — hot reload or near-instant preview after a script change

citations.quote: Live Coding is a system that can rebuild your application's C++ code and patch its binaries while the engine is running.
Running your application with Play In Editor (PIE).
Use UE Toolbar to quickly test a part of your currently loaded Level for testing and debugging.
